evidence.excerpt: # BUG REPORT: Webhook-triggered agent runs fail with RuntimeStoreError('not_found') on multiplexed gateways (dynamic + static routes) ## Environment - Hermes Agent v0.23.2 (2026.9.24), install method: git, commit ae2a81c

jobStory.zh: 当使用Hermes Agent v0.23.2处理动态+静态路由的multiplexed gateway时，独立开发者想要触发webhook并让对应agent运行，以便完成工作流自动化。
jobStory.en: When using Hermes Agent v0.23.2 with dynamic+static routes on multiplexed gateways, indie devs want to trigger webhooks and run agents to automate workflows.

pain.zh: 在尝试触发webhook时，agent会因RuntimeStoreError('not_found')直接失败，导致工作流无法继续推进。
pain.en: Attempting to trigger a webhook causes the agent to fail immediately with RuntimeStoreError('not_found'), preventing workflow progression.

workaround.zh: 假设开发者目前只能放弃该webhook触发操作，等待问题修复后再重新尝试。
workaround.en: Assuming devs currently must abandon the webhook attempt and retry after the issue is fixed.

rootObstacle.zh: 系统无法在动态+静态路由混合的gateway环境中定位到目标agent实例，导致存储查询失败。
rootObstacle.en: The system cannot locate target agent instances in a gateway with mixed dynamic+static routes, causing storage lookup failures.

build.en: Build a function that quickly locates agent instances based on route rules, returning the instance ID from route configuration.

stopIf.zh: 若测试用例中函数始终返回错误或空值，则无需继续开发。
stopIf.en: If the function always returns errors or null values in test cases, stop development.
